curator: assistant; human source and meaning review pending
selection_basis: Qualitative diversity of attribution, revision, modality, reference, imagery and pragmatic purpose; not observed model performance or a probability sample.

gutenberg.observation: The three catalog records identify these works as public domain in the USA. The site distinguishes underlying book text from its trademark/license and requires users elsewhere to check local law.
gutenberg.decision: Metadata citation only at this stage; no blanket worldwide reuse or API-processing clearance. Check the license inside each acquired edition before excerpt publication. Keep attribution and the edition record separate from model input.

chronicling_america.observation: LOC describes the collection as public domain or without known copyright restrictions and gives a US publication-age rule; it leaves independent rights assessment to the user.
chronicling_america.decision: Promising US reuse basis for these 1904-1910 issues, not a global legal conclusion. Check source-specific notices, derivative transcription and intended publication/API scope before admission.

input_exclusions: Search-engine or assistant summaries used as source prose
Silent OCR repair, modernization or translation
Editorial annotations silently attributed to the letter writer
Questions, answer keys or evidence ledgers shown to senders
